hook.name: HoodlumPadHook
hook.description: Shared Uniswap v4 hook for HoodlumPad V2 memecoin launches. Skims a fixed 1% fee from memecoin swaps (split 50/50 between creator and protocol treasury) as ERC-6909 claim tokens, maintains a self-hosted 200-slot TWAP oracle, and provides a batched fee-conversion mechanism to swap accrued memecoin fees into the quote asset.
